verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲ ਨੀਉ ਧਰਾਈਓਨੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚਖੰਡ ਸਮੇਉ।
verses.translit_en: nihachal neeau dharaieeon saadhasa(n)gat sachakha(n)dd sameau|

en.bdb: The steadfast foundation of the abode of truth in the form of holy congregation was laid thoughtfully (by Guru Na-nak Dev)

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਚਲਾਇਓਨੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਅਮੇਉ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh pa(n)th chalaion sukh saagar bea(n)t ameau|

en.bdb: And he promulgated gurmukh-panth (Sikhism) which is ocean of infinite pleasures.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਉ।
verses.translit_en: sach sabadh aaraadheeaai agam agochar alakh abheau|

en.bdb: There, true word is practised which is unapproachable, imperceptible and mystical.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਹੁ ਵਰਨਾ ਉਪਦੇਸਦਾ ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨ ਸਭਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਉ।
verses.translit_en: chahu varanaa upadhesadhaa chhia dharasan sabh sevak seau|

en.bdb: That abode of truth preaches to all the four varnas and all the six philosophies (of Indian origin) remain absorbed in its service.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਨਿਵ ਚਲਣੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਅਰਥੇਉ।
verses.translit_en: miThaa bolan niv chalan gurmukh bhaau bhagat aratheau|

en.bdb: Gurmukhs (there) speak sweetly, move humbly and are seekers of devotion.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਹੈ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਤਿ ਅਛਲ ਅਛੇਉ।
verses.translit_en: aadh purakh aadhes hai abinaasee at achhal achheau|

en.bdb: Salutations are due to that primal Lord who is undestructible, undeceivable and unending.
Guru Nanak is the enlightener (Guru) of the entire world.
